transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... honestly, I feel like I'm just falling apart lately. Ever since they changed my hours at the warehouse and put in this whole new inventory system, it's just been too much. I've been missing my shifts, which isn't like me, and I haven't been going to my church commitments either. I find myself snapping at my family all the time. Some mornings, I just... I sit there in my work boots, staring at the wall, just wondering if I can even face going into that place anymore. It's really getting bad.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day?

No, I wouldn't say I'm sad or down most of the day. I mean, I'm definitely stressed and overwhelmed with everything going on at work, but it's not like a deep sadness or anything like that. It's more just... feeling like I can't keep up.
Have you been feeling unusually nervous or on edge?

No, I wouldn't say I feel nervous. I don't really get jittery or feel on edge like I'm waiting for something bad to happen. It's just... well, like I said, it's just that heavy feeling of being completely overwhelmed by all the changes they made, but not nervous.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I told you I haven't been going to my church commitments lately, but it's not because I don't enjoy it anymore. I still like the idea of going and seeing folks. It's just... I'm so drained from dealing with the warehouse stuff that I just can't bring myself to go. But no, I haven't lost interest in the things I actually like doing.
